PocketShelf - native PocketBook library browser

Copy the applications folder onto your reader, merging it with the existing
applications folder. Safely eject, then open Apps > PocketShelf.

When logged out, only the login form is shown. Edit Email and Password,
then tap Sign in. After login, the main menu shows your email at the top right.
Choose Search the library. Use the physical Back button to exit.
Select a book, browse Description / Book info, tap Download [format], then Open in PocketBook reader.
All documented Era Color ebook, image and audio formats are enabled, including MOBI.
Search defaults to all formats; change the filter in Account & settings.

Device diagnostics confirm successful login and 24-bit color mode.
Downloading and native book opening have been verified on the reader.
Native Library indexing and Cloud upload still need on-device verification.
The default z-library.sk login endpoint now passes its cookie redirect handshake
in an anonymous development probe; real login also succeeded on the reader.
You can change the HTTPS library address on the login form. Errors are shown red
and the app requests a 24-bit color framebuffer.

Books: Books/PocketShelf/
Session and startup log: system/config/pocketshelf/
Password is not stored; the saved session token is accessible over USB.
Sign out from Settings to forget it.

If the app fails to start, reconnect by USB and retrieve
system/config/pocketshelf/last-run.log.

Inner pages have a Back button at the top left. The main menu keeps the
current user at the top right and has no Close button.
